title: On Measuring Faithfulness or Self-consistency of Natural Language Explanations
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The central concept of 'faithfulness' in this paper is a technical term from Explainable AI (XAI), referring to whether a model's generated explanation accurately reflects its internal reasoning process, not religious faith.
findings: The paper presents no findings related to religion, as it is not a subject of the research. The findings focus on the self-consistency of LLM explanations, with 'chat' models generally showing higher consistency than base models, and the proposed CC-SHAP metric correlating most with counterfactual editing tests.
